description: This script manages translation workflows for documentation, including generating paths, translating pages via an AI agent, and automating GitHub PR creation. It uses FastAPI-related commands and integrates with Git, GitHub, and language files.

methods.name: get_langs
methods.description: Cached function to load language names from a YAML file.

methods.name: generate_lang_path
methods.description: Generates a path for a specific language version of a documentation file.

methods.name: generate_en_path
methods.description: Generates the English version path from a language-specific path.

methods.name: translate_page
methods.description: Translates a documentation page into a specified language using an AI agent, handling existing translations and prompts.

methods.name: iter_all_en_paths
methods.description: Iterates over all English documentation markdown files in priority order.

methods.name: iter_en_paths_to_translate
methods.description: Filters English documentation files that need translation, excluding non-translatable sections.

methods.name: list_llm_translatable
methods.description: Lists languages that can be translated via LLM based on presence of prompt files.

methods.name: llm_translatable_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of translatable languages, optionally filtered by a specific language.

methods.name: commands_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of available commands or a specific command.

methods.name: list_removable
methods.description: Lists documentation files in a language that can be removed because they lack English counterparts.

methods.name: list_all_removable
methods.description: Lists all removable documentation files across all languages.

methods.name: remove_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable documentation files for a specified language.

methods.name: remove_all_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable documentation files across all languages.

methods.name: list_missing
methods.description: Lists documentation files that are missing translations in a specified language.

methods.name: list_outdated
methods.description: Lists translation files that are outdated compared to the English source based on commit times.

methods.name: update_outdated
methods.description: Updates translation files that are outdated.

methods.name: add_missing
methods.description: Adds missing translations for documentation files.

methods.name: update_and_add
methods.description: Performs both update of outdated and addition of missing translations.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, handling branch creation and commits.
